data.description: The tool that confuses everyone but prints the memes.
Every eye gets a player. The mouth opens another window, and the copy somehow looks more certain than the original.
A fatal error asks for yes, then offers OK? I respect that level of confidence. I will sit by the window, smoke, and let the machine explain itself.
